baseline_models.mechanism: The forgiveness branch is not bare deletion: it covers the fault while preserving its bearer from the fault's consequence, and the Lord branch adds repair and stage-by-stage care.

activation_trace.role: Covering a fault while shielding its bearer from the resulting harm supplies the protective core of forgiveness.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the named Lord the agent of restorative care rather than only acquittal.

changed_reading.before: My Lord simply canceled a fault.
changed_reading.after: My Lord covered the fault's damaging reach and restoratively secured me.

baseline_models.mechanism: The causative making places the speaker in a new condition, while the partitive construction makes honor a collective belonging rather than a detachable possession.

activation_trace.role: Making someone into a condition or rank supplies an enacted transition rather than a mere description.
Commendable nobility, generosity, and honor define the collective into which the speaker is placed.

changed_reading.after: He actively relocated me into the fellowship and standing of the honored.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier promise pairs forgiveness with a noble reward; the focus turns the first noun into a completed divine verb and the noble quality into the recipient's new collective identity.

activation_trace.role: The completed forgiveness anchors the first half of the earlier promise in the speaker's experience.
The honored class turns noble quality from an attribute of reward into a condition of the recipient.
Promised forgiveness supplies the same protective mercy later reported as accomplished.
Recompense for action gives the promised second benefit a reward structure.
Noble honor qualifies the promised reward and provides the lexical bridge to the honored group.

structural_cues: 36:11 coordinates forgiveness and noble reward; 36:27 coordinates being forgiven and being made one of the honored.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root pair and order; I infer narrative realization, while a live alternative is deliberate thematic echo without a one-to-one fulfillment claim.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports two isolated private favors.
changed_reading.after: The speaker embodies the surah's earlier two-part promise: protective forgiveness has become fact, and noble reward has become honored identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is the content governed by the speaker's wish that his people know; its first-person mercy and honor therefore function as evidence addressed outward, not as private self-congratulation.

activation_trace.role: Forgiveness is the first fact the speaker wants his audience to understand.
Honored belonging is the second fact offered as persuasive testimony.
Hearing as understanding and responsive compliance frames the speaker's last direct appeal for uptake.
The people remain the intended social beneficiaries of what follows.
Disclosure to a knower makes the focus clauses the missing knowledge the speaker wishes to transmit.

structural_cues: The incomplete wish in 36:26, يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ, is completed by the focus's بِمَا clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the governing wish and audience; I infer a persuasive testimonial aim, while the materially live alternative is compassion without an intended argument.

changed_reading.before: The speaker celebrates his own rescue and elevation.
changed_reading.after: He offers his rescue and elevation as the knowledge he still wants his rejecting people to receive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah preserves deeds, residual traces, and bodily testimony, while the focus branch defines forgiveness as shielding the bearer from a fault's effect. Mercy can therefore alter liability or consequence without requiring the evidentiary trace to disappear.

activation_trace.role: Protection from a fault's effect, rather than deletion of all trace, anchors the revised model.
Writing as an establishment carrying judgment or decree supplies durable accountability.
A remaining mark that indicates what occurred makes persistence of consequence-bearing evidence explicit.
Testimony as informed declaration makes the body's evidence active rather than forgotten.
Acquired action identifies what the testimony concerns and preserves the accountability frame.

structural_cues: 36:12 records both what people sent ahead and their آثار; 36:65 makes limbs testify about what they acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preserved traces and protective covering; I infer that forgiveness changes harmful consequence rather than archival fact, while an alternative is that the recorded traces do not include the matter forgiven here.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness means that the incriminating past has been erased.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness can mean that a fully preserved and witnessed past no longer reaches the forgiven person with its damaging effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later recompense rule and the opposed بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ formula make the focus's بِمَا ... غَفَرَ ... وَجَعَلَ sound like the mercy-side pronouncement within a paired economy of outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Protective forgiveness supplies the positive verdict's release from harmful consequence.
Placement into a new state supplies the positive verdict's resulting condition.
Matching action with its recompense establishes the surah's explicit outcome rule.
Purposive action supplies the conduct to which recompense is related.
Covering the truth supplies the opposed conduct named in the later بِمَا verdict.

structural_cues: 36:27 and 36:64 both place بِمَا after an entry imperative and before the clause that grounds or names the resulting state.
36:54 states that recompense corresponds to what was done.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula and recompense rule; I infer a deliberate verdict contrast, while the live grammatical alternative is that the focus's مَا names or magnifies what was forgiven rather than functioning causally.

changed_reading.before: The opening بِمَا is only a locally ambiguous connective.
changed_reading.after: The whole surah lets it sound as the merciful counterpart to the later condemnation formula: one outcome is forgiveness and honored placement, the other exposure to fire for covering truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier divine making installs constriction, barriers, and an occluding cover; the same causative root in the focus instead installs the speaker within honored belonging, while forgiveness supplies a cover that protects rather than blinds.

activation_trace.role: Making into a condition anchors the positive re-placement of the speaker.
A cover that preserves and protects supplies the beneficial counterpart to occlusion.
The same making verb installs a disabling bodily condition and makes divine placement morally polarized.
A collar binding the organ materializes constricted placement.
Repeated making extends the imposed condition into the speaker's spatial counter-image.
Closing gaps with barriers supplies enclosure before and behind.
A cover that overtops and hides supplies the harmful occlusion against which forgiving cover is differentiated.

structural_cues: The earlier جَعَلْنَا clauses place restraints in necks and barriers around people; the focus's جَعَلَنِى مِنْ construction places the speaker within a human class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated causation and opposed spatial complements; I infer contrastive re-placement, while an alternative is that the repeated verb marks divine agency without a direct reversal.

changed_reading.before: Being made one of the honored is a generic promotion.
changed_reading.after: It is the positive counter-placement to the surah's imposed constriction: protective covering replaces blinding cover, and honored affiliation replaces immobilizing enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal gathering is followed by named garden companionship, safety spoken from a merciful Lord, and explicit separation of offenders. The focus's partitive honored membership becomes a destination within communal sorting and reception.

activation_trace.role: Honorable standing names the positive collective into which the speaker is placed.
Gathering dispersed persons into one whole supplies the universal field from which classes can be distinguished.
Brought presence and witnessed nearness make the gathering an adjudicative arrival.
Companionship and abiding association give the positive class a relational form.
The tree-covered garden supplies the shared setting of the positive company.
Safety and freedom from harm fill honored reception with more than prestige.
The sovereign Lord directly addresses the garden company and echoes the speaker's my Lord.
Sorting until one group becomes distinct from another supplies the opposed classification.

structural_cues: The focus's مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ is explicitly partitive; later the surah gathers everyone, names garden companions, addresses them with peace, and separates offenders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, positive companionship, divine greeting, and separation; I infer that the honored are aligned with this positive communal destination, while the exact label need not exhaustively equal garden companions.

changed_reading.before: Honor is an abstract individual rank.
changed_reading.after: Honor is selective yet communal reception: presence among companions, safety under the Lord's address, and distinction within the gathered whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker already links his first origination to return, and the surah later argues from first production and from making fire emerge as a condition of green material. The focus's making can therefore carry an ontological re-creative force alongside social appointment.

activation_trace.role: Transformation into a new condition anchors the personal re-making.
Origination and first production supply the speaker's initial making.
Return to a prior source supplies the trajectory in which a second condition becomes possible.
Bringing a thing into being explicitly reconnects revival to first production.
The same making root effects a condition that appears materially contrary to its source.
Tender green vegetation supplies the living material pole of the transformation.
Kindled fire supplies the apparently contrary resulting condition.

structural_cues: The man's own speech moves from the One who originated me to return, while the closing argument links first creation, revival, and a repeated جَعَلَ transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origin-return and creative transformations; I infer that personal honored placement participates in re-creation, while the live alternative is that جَعَلَنِى denotes rank alone after entry.

changed_reading.before: The Lord merely appointed the speaker to a higher social rank.
changed_reading.after: The Lord reconstituted the returned speaker into an honored mode of life, with appointment and renewed being carried together.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The direct branch phrase for striving includes pursuit of noble deeds, making the bridge unusually sharp, and refusal of human wage supplies a coherent counter-economy anchored in being made honored. The causal arrow from running and unpriced service to divine honor is reader-supplied, however; downstream prose should present this as an embodied resonance, not as the lexical meaning of مُكْرَمِينَ or a claim that honor was earned.

activation_trace.role: Transformation into honored standing supplies the endpoint of the proposed movement.
Noble honor supplies the state toward which the contextual striving resonates.
Pursuit of noble deeds turns the man's run from the city's edge into a bodily trajectory of honor.
The denied request for human recompense makes later divine honor noncommercial and unpriced.

changed_reading.before: The honored state is static compensation after the story.
changed_reading.after: His purposive run from the margin and service without human fee become an embodied path that resonates with his being placed among the honored.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation: the Lord inventory carries cultivation and the honor inventory carries fertile plant quality, while the surah moves through dead earth, revived growth, and beneficial fruit. It remains anchored in two focus roots and a coherent revival sequence, but the focus morphology ordinarily names honored persons; downstream prose should call it an ecological analogy of flourishing, never substitute vegetation for social honor.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and gradual completion supply the cultivator side of the analogy.
Excellent vegetation and beneficent rain supply flourishing as an exploratory image of honored condition.
Earth revived through rain and growth supplies the surah's explicit cultivation-after-death process.
Fruit as realized benefit gives cultivated flourishing a functional outcome.

changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological resonance, the Lord has cultivated the speaker from exposed mortality into a flourishing, beneficial mode of life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The lid sense under the honor root is form-distant from مُكْرَمِينَ, so this cannot control translation. It remains worth carrying because the focus coordinates one protective cover with honored placement and the later garden scene adds shade and safety; downstream prose should mark it strictly as a material analogy of layered shelter.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover supplies the first protective layer.
A lid placed over a vessel supplies a distant material image for honor closing protectively over the recipient.
Sheltering shade extends the material cover image into the garden company.
Safety and freedom from harm name the protective result of the layered shelter.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and honor are two abstract awards.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, forgiveness covers the damaging past and honored reception closes over the person as shelter, shade, and safety.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The immediate denial of a heavenly army makes this social reading visible: the man is placed into an honored collective without military mobilization against his former collective. The packet does not explicitly call this a transfer of allegiance, and his wish preserves care for his people; downstream prose should describe nonmilitary vindication and enlarged affiliation, not repudiation of his people.

activation_trace.role: The honored collective supplies a new affiliation that does not depend on worldly force.
His people remain the social body for whom he desires knowledge, preventing the new affiliation from becoming simple rejection.
A mutually supporting force is explicitly not sent, separating honor from military vindication.
Life or awareness stilled after movement shows that the people's end occurs independently of an army or the man's public triumph.

changed_reading.before: The man's honor is validated by visible victory over his opponents.
changed_reading.after: His honor is already complete as nonmilitary belonging; no army establishes it, and his concern for his people survives their rejection.

strongest_changes: The focus realizes the earlier paired promise of forgiveness and noble reward by turning it into completed protection and honored identity.
The clause is outward testimony governed by the wish that the speaker's people know, not private self-celebration.
Whole-surah recording and bodily testimony sharpen forgiveness into protection from a preserved past's harmful effect rather than erasure of evidence.
Repeated making, gathering, separation, and creation make honored membership both communal classification and re-creative transformation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made a compact first-person report operate simultaneously as fulfilled promise, missing public message, mercy-side verdict, reversal of constrictive placement, and prototype of the surah's later gathering and re-creation.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact force of مَا in بِمَا remains live between causal, nominal, and magnifying readings.
The packet supports but does not settle how action, gratuitous mercy, and reward are directionally related.
The honored group aligns strongly with later garden companionship, but the text does not explicitly equate the labels.
The cultivated and material-shelter outliers depend on branch-distant analogies and must remain qualified resonances.
